external_collaboration.evidence_quote: One of the largest university cooperations worldwide, the Baltic University Programme (BUP) covers approximately 90 universities including 13 medical schools and numerous other university departments whose work focuses on Medical Technologies, Public Health, Health and Society. These institutions are jointly involved in research and educational activities in the field of sustainable development and democracy and are represented in the 14 countries surrounding the Baltic Sea.

The team has now been accepted into the university network of junior neurologists within the German Neurology Society DGN. The two initiators are highly pleased and looking forward to participation in exciting projects. 21 universities are actively engaged in the network.
